summary: ICP canister-based React app (Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui) with Motoko backend and a Valentine-themed multi-section interactive experience including memory overlays, heart particle effects, and music controls; includes an ICP build/deploy template and Internet Identity integration scaffolding.

existing_features.title: ICP build/deploy template (Dockerfile, scripts, canister configs)
existing_features.description: Project includes an ICP-focused build template with Dockerfile, deploy scripts, canister YAML configs, and workspace/package setup for building and deploying backend/frontend canisters.

existing_features.title: Motoko backend canister scaffold
existing_features.description: Motoko backend canister code and Candid/IDL scaffolding are present (e.g., backend/main.mo plus system IDL).

existing_features.title: React/Vite frontend scaffold with Tailwind + shadcn/ui component library
existing_features.description: Frontend is a React app built with Vite, Tailwind CSS, and a large set of shadcn/ui components and utilities configured in the repository.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity integration hooks/scaffolding
existing_features.description: Frontend includes hooks and configuration for Internet Identity-based authentication and actor creation against the backend canister.

existing_features.title: Valentine-themed multi-interface experience with memory menu + overlays
existing_features.description: App includes multiple UI sections (proposal/celebration/memory menu/final surprise) with a memory icon grid and overlay-driven content sections (e.g., How We Met, Letters, Playlist, etc.).

existing_features.title: Heart/romance visual effects system
existing_features.description: Frontend includes reusable effects components for floating hearts background, occasional hearts, click heart particles, and heart burst transitions.

existing_features.title: Music controller + toggle
existing_features.description: Frontend includes music playback control components (MusicController, MusicToggle) used within the experience.

existing_features.title: Generated icon assets for memory sections
existing_features.description: Project includes generated 256x256 icon assets for multiple memory sections stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.

architectural_notes: Monorepo includes an ICP-focused build template (Docker-based) with separate backend/frontend canister configuration.
Frontend stack: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui component set.
Auth scaffolding present for Internet Identity (hooks for identity/actor).
Frontend organized into multi-section experience + overlay-based memory content sections with shared effects components.
Build template expanded/refined as a reusable pnpm workspace with frontend/backend canister YAMLs, custom ESLint rules, and utility scripts (e.g., image resize/prune).
